setup: The child care center staff access the application through a standard web browser on a desktop or tablet device.
action: A staff member opens the application home page from the center's web address.
expected_observation: The child care management system loads in the browser and presents center staff with a web-based interface that can be used without installing desktop software.

setup: A front office staff member is managing family, child, classroom, enrollment, and billing records that are already stored in the system.
action: The staff member completes a typical task such as registering a family, updating a child's record, or generating an invoice.
expected_observation: The task is completed within the shared system records, and the staff member does not need to re-enter the same information in separate paper files or disconnected tools.

setup: A child, their family, their classroom assignment, and their billing history already exist in the center's records.
action: An authorized staff member opens the child's profile from the system and navigates between family, classroom, and billing sections.
expected_observation: The system shows the linked family, child, classroom, and billing information in one place, using the same current record set for staff reviewing or updating the child's details.

setup: An administrator has valid login credentials and permission to manage center records.
action: The administrator signs in to the child care management system and opens the administrative dashboard.
expected_observation: The system grants access to administrator functions such as registration, enrollment, billing, and reports.

setup: A front office or enrollment staff member has valid credentials and permission to handle admissions and family records.
action: The staff member signs in and opens the enrollment area of the system.
expected_observation: The system provides access to enrollment-related tasks such as family registration, waiting lists, and child placement workflows.

setup: A teacher has valid credentials and permission to view classroom-related child information.
action: The teacher signs in and opens the classroom roster or child profile for their assigned class.
expected_observation: The system allows the teacher to view the children assigned to the classroom and access relevant child information needed for daily classroom work.

setup: An authorized center employee has valid credentials and permission to view child or billing information.
action: The employee signs in and opens the appropriate child record or billing record.
expected_observation: The system displays the requested child or billing information according to the employee's authorization level.

setup: The system has been configured for center staff use only, and no parent or guardian account type has been enabled.
action: A staff member reviews the available user roles and portal options in the system.
expected_observation: The system shows only staff-facing access and does not present a confirmed parent or guardian portal for viewing forms, invoices, or updates.

setup: An administrator is signed in and the center has no existing record for a new family.
action: The administrator enters the family's contact details and submits the registration form.
expected_observation: The system creates the family record and makes the new family available for later enrollment, child, and billing activities.

setup: A child care center has an active enrollment period and an opening exists for a child in a program or classroom.
action: An enrollment staff member enrolls a child into the center or updates an existing enrollment record.
expected_observation: The system saves the enrollment details, links the child to the correct family and classroom information, and reflects the enrollment status in the center records.

setup: A classroom has a defined maximum capacity and the current number of enrolled children is below that limit.
action: A staff member assigns an additional child to the classroom until the capacity limit is reached.
expected_observation: The system tracks the classroom occupancy and shows when the class reaches its capacity so staff can see whether more children can be assigned.

setup: A classroom or program has no available space for a child who still needs placement.
action: A staff member adds the child to the waiting list for that classroom or program.
expected_observation: The system records the child on the waiting list and displays the child's waiting status for future placement review.

setup: A child record exists for an enrolled child and immunization details have not yet been fully documented.
action: A staff member opens the child's health record and enters one or more immunization entries with dates.
expected_observation: The system stores the immunization information in the child's record and allows staff to review the child's immunization status later.

setup: A child has active attendance or fee-based charges that need to be billed to a family account.
action: A billing staff member generates an invoice for the family for the applicable billing period.
expected_observation: The system creates an invoice showing the billed charges, the associated family, and the amount due.

setup: An administrator or authorized staff member is signed in and operational data such as enrollment, attendance, classroom, or billing records exist in the system.
action: The staff member opens a center operations report such as enrollment totals, billing summary, or classroom utilization.
expected_observation: The system displays a report with center operations information that staff can review for management and administrative decisions.

setup: The center director is signed in to Nenios Child Care Management and has access to the reporting area, with attendance, enrollment, billing, and room occupancy data already recorded for the current month.
action: The director opens the reports menu and requests a customer-facing monthly statement and an operations report for center capacity and attendance.
expected_observation: The system generates and displays the requested reports with accurate, date-bounded information; the customer report shows each child's charges and attendance summary, and the operations report shows enrollment counts, attendance totals, and room occupancy metrics in a readable format that can be printed or exported.

setup: A billing clerk is signed in and at least one child account has completed care sessions, applied discounts, and an outstanding balance for the current billing cycle.
action: The clerk opens the invoicing screen, selects the eligible child accounts, and requests invoice generation for the billing period.
expected_observation: The system automatically prepares invoices using the recorded attendance and rate rules, calculates charges and discounts consistently, and presents draft invoices with totals, due dates, and line-item details that the clerk can review, edit if permitted, and finalize without manual recalculation.

setup: A program manager is signed in and the center has recorded daily attendance, enrollment, and billing activity for multiple rooms and age groups.
action: The manager opens the reporting workspace and selects a standard operational summary report for the current week.
expected_observation: The system presents the report in a clear, organized format with the relevant summary figures already compiled, reducing the need for manual data gathering; the manager can quickly view key measures such as enrollment, attendance, and billing status without assembling information from separate screens.

setup: A child has been placed on a waiting list for a full classroom, and later a vacancy becomes available in that same classroom for the appropriate age group and schedule.
action: An enrollment coordinator attempts to enroll the child while the child is still marked as waiting, then confirms the enrollment when the opening is selected.
expected_observation: The system prevents duplicate or inconsistent placement by ensuring the child cannot remain both waiting-listed and actively enrolled for the same slot; when the enrollment is confirmed, the waiting list entry is updated or removed, the enrollment record is created once, and the classroom roster reflects the child only in the enrolled state.
